cc:Work.dc:title: FramedBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
A box in which every face is a frame
This box is more of a building block than a finished item. Use a vector graphics program (like Inkscape) to add any features.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes FramedBox --reference 0 Command line short: boxes FramedBox --reference
